assessment.nobel_worthiness: IceCube opened high-energy neutrino astronomy, a genuinely new observational channel with major discovery potential.
assessment.attribution: The proposed names represent the scientific leadership and realization of the large, difficult detector enterprise.
assessment.maturity: The astrophysical neutrino signal is established and the observatory has delivered a durable new capability.
uncertainties: A collaboration-scale discovery makes the division of decisive individual credit intrinsically difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Event Horizon Telescope imaging made a striking, long-sought measurement at the scale of a black-hole shadow.
assessment.attribution: The three names plausibly span the conceptual prediction, physical interpretation, and instrumental realization.
assessment.maturity: Multiple EHT results and increasingly sophisticated observations make this more than a single dramatic image.
uncertainties: The result rests on a very large collaboration and the best boundaries between prediction, technique, and discovery require careful review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The experimental discovery of the Higgs boson was a central confirmation of fundamental particle physics.
assessment.attribution: These candidates represent leadership behind the two experiments that supplied the independent discovery evidence.
assessment.maturity: The particle's properties have been extensively tested since the 2012 announcement.
uncertainties: The scale of ATLAS and CMS makes any three-person attribution necessarily incomplete.
Theoretical recognition of the mechanism was already awarded, affecting the framing of a further prize.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP made precision cosmology a quantitative observational science and sharply constrained the standard cosmological model.
assessment.attribution: The selection reasonably joins experimental leadership, analysis, and cosmological interpretation.
assessment.maturity: Its results have had lasting impact and are supported by later, more precise measurements.
uncertainties: It may be judged an exceptionally important refinement of earlier CMB work rather than a separate discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Silicon microstrip and hybrid-pixel detectors transformed particle tracking and enabled an unusually broad range of measurements.
assessment.attribution: The named contributors offer a coherent route to recognizing foundational detector concepts and implementation.
assessment.maturity: The technology is long proven in collider experiments and has demonstrated wide scientific utility.
uncertainties: The innovation developed through many laboratories and applications, so priority and individual credit need close historical examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Transit measurements and the Kepler census changed planetary astrophysics from isolated detections to population science.
assessment.attribution: The candidates represent early transit work and the mission that established the statistical census.
assessment.maturity: The large and continuing exoplanet inventory has firmly validated the method and its scientific consequences.
uncertainties: Priority is distributed across several discovery methods, missions, and survey teams.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks have pushed time and frequency measurement to a new regime with deep scientific and technological consequences.
assessment.attribution: Katori and Ye are clear central figures in the invention and experimental development of the field.
assessment.maturity: Independent laboratories now achieve extraordinary reproducibility and the technique supports demanding tests and applications.
uncertainties: Its ultimate role in timekeeping standards and fundamental discoveries is still developing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Squeezed light turned a quantum limit into a practical route to improved interferometric sensitivity, notably for gravitational-wave astronomy.
assessment.attribution: The proposed laureates represent the foundational quantum-measurement concept and major experimental implementation.
assessment.maturity: Operational use in precision interferometers establishes the technique as a reliable scientific instrument.
uncertainties: The contribution overlaps substantially with broader gravitational-wave detector development and quantum-optics advances.
